leadText:
Alice Telesu (Japanese: テレス・アリス Alice Telesu) is a character of the day who appeared in A Crowning Achievement.

Alice was traveling with her archaeologist father, who was studying hieroglyphics near a lake full of that suffered a drought after an earthquake. According to the hieroglyphics, a Slowpoke needed to evolve into a to save the colony, but the in the lake kept on latching on to the Slowpoke and causing them to evolve into . Alice's Slowpoke, Arthur, was able to make it, and was intelligent enough to lead the Slowpoke and Slowbro into an underground cave where water was plentiful.

Alice was saddened to see Arthur, who she had known since he was a baby, go. Nevertheless, she knew that it was for the best that he leave.
